ns2:course.label: Comp-Aided Product Realization
ns2:course.description: Computer-aided design, analysis, and prototyping tools used in the produce development process. Principles of computer graphics and geometric modeling, including transformations, coordinate systems, parametric solid modeling, spline curves, and surface modeling. Finite element and kinematics analyses. Rapid prototyping, product dissection, CAD-CAM-CAE operability issues, and CAD collaboration tools. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: SE 101 and SE 311.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: SE 101 and SE 311.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BS:Engineering Mechanics -UIUC, BS:General Engineering -UIUC, BS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, BS:Bioengineering - UIUC, BS:Systems Engr & Design -UIUC, BFA:Industrial Design -UIUC, MS:Industrial Engr Online-UIUC, MFA:A&D - Industrial Dsg -UIUC, MS:Sys & Entreprnural Eng-UIUC, MS:Industrial Engineerng -UIUC, PHD:Industrial Enginerng -UIUC, or PHD:Sys&Entreprnural Eng-UIUC.
